title: Operationalizing content moderation “accuracy” in the Digital Services Act
reasoning: The paper focuses on the legal and technical operationalization of accuracy metrics for content moderation under the Digital Services Act. It uses statistical estimation and NLP classifiers (RoBERTa, DistilBERT) to evaluate precision and recall. While the paper includes a brief 'Ethical considerations' section and references fundamental rights, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or specific ethical frameworks.
